name: TapeOsc
description: Varispeed oscillator with a tape-motor spin-up. One platform band-limited saw, square, triangle, or sine runs at tape speed. Note-on starts the motor; the host amp envelope fades the release.

params.name: WAVE
params.detail: Waveform: saw, square, triangle, sine. Uses the logue band-limited tables.

params.name: START
params.detail: Tape motor spin-up time in milliseconds (10-2000)

params.name: WOW
params.detail: Wow and flutter depth, 0-100%. 100% is about ±10% tape speed.
